about_the_game:
The highly anticipated follow up to Indoor Kickball!

Indoor Baseball is BIGGER, better, and even more destructive!

Indoor Baseball is a 1v1 baseball game played in the rooms of your house! Play in a goofy story mode to work your way up to make the school baseball team. Play a 14 game randomly generated season mode, or quick play 1v1 in a local multiplayer match against a friend or CPU.

This is a demo of Indoor Baseball where you can pitch and bat in a 6 out home run derby. Check out the batting and pitches mechanics and give feedback and ideas for adding to the full release of Indoor Baseball coming in Summer 2025!

  • Play as action figure sized players and launch home runs over the builder blocks home run wall

  • Hit and destroy things over the wall for bonus points and crazy surprises!

  • Choose from 3 different characters with their own stats and pitch types (Full game will include 12+ character)

  • Play in 2 different home run derby fields

  • Play against the CPU or against a friend in local multiplayer (*requires controller for 2nd player)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 460
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660 or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
